verdict.rationale: Branded stablecoin issuance is a fair question for stablecoin infrastructure like Paxos, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only mint and redeem orchestrations and reserve reporting for Paxos's own coins (USDG, PYUSD, USDP). It shows no white-label or branded issuance product for a founder and quotes no gating for one. Converting USD into existing Paxos stablecoins is an adjacent capability, not issuing your own coin.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue a branded stablecoin on the platform's infrastructure — a documented issuance product covering minting, redemption, and reserve management, with its gating quoted honestly

citations.quote: Convert USD to Stablecoins and transfer all in one call.
Convert stablecoins to USD and withdraw to your bank in one call.
Paxos publishes monthly reports on reserve composition as well as attestations reports
